correctness.rationale: An unrestricted symbolic proof reduces c_r equality to degree-marked nonbacktracking unfolding depth r−1, gives three sharp lower witnesses, and at T discriminates every reflection orbit using marked distances. An orbit partition is equitable, hence stabilized. Standalone verify.py checks 2730 parameter pairs and independently checks the unfolded-view equivalence at all rounds in 160 instances. Boundary m=3, ell=1 and central even/odd tail cases are explicitly covered.

originality.rationale: The exact all-integer two-parameter formula and its three distinct obstructions are not implied by the identified literature on graph amenability, relative unicyclic identification, globally maximal 1-WL rounds, or low-degree long-refinement graphs. Results that already settle relative unicyclic isomorphism are not re-claimed. Search evidence is not treated as proof of historical uniqueness.
